root_cause: selected_queue previously preferred the default R42 ready-family manifest over an explicit --family-queue, so manifest-backed startup/recovery planning could continue to see PatchTST even after operators supplied a queue without PatchTST. Crash/restart admission then flowed through certified_queue_admission_plan when --admit-crashed-recoverable or sequence V3 readiness made the family eligible.
post_patch_invariant: canonical_family_name(family) in effective_excluded_families => never launch automatically
